title: Shredded Collard Green Salad with Roasted Sweet Potatoes and Cashews
author: Pierre Thiam (credited author; page carries no byline) — SAVEUR
desc: Sweet potato slices roasted 40 minutes at 400° with cumin, thyme and garlic, tossed over collards shredded fine and massaged about 5 minutes with a palm-oil and lime dressing, topped with goat cheese and cashews.
longDesc: A SAVEUR salad from Pierre Thiam’s Thanksgiving feature (16 November 2015). Sweet potato slices are tossed with 2 tablespoons of palm oil, cumin, thyme and garlic, seasoned and roasted at 400° about 40 minutes, flipping once, until golden brown. Lime juice and ginger stand 10 minutes to soften, then the remaining 1/4 cup of palm oil is whisked in until emulsified. The shredded collards are tossed with 1 tablespoon of the dressing and massaged about 5 minutes, then topped with the potatoes, goat cheese and cashews and served with the rest of the dressing. The recipe page carries no byline (photo credit Ryan Liebe); the parent article and credited author are Pierre Thiam. The page says West Africans cook ‘virtually every dish they make with red palm oil’.
ingredients: 2 lb sweet potatoes, peeled and cut crosswise into 1/2-inch-thick slices
1/4 cup plus 2 tablespoons red palm oil or vegetable oil
Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper — quantities not printed
1 lb collard greens, stems removed, leaves thinly shredded (6 cups)
1/4 cup roasted, unsalted cashews, roughly chopped
steps: Heat the oven to 400°. Toss the sweet potato slices on a rimmed baking sheet with 2 tablespoons of the palm oil, the cumin, thyme and garlic; season. Roast about 40 minutes, flipping once halfway, until golden brown. Move to a rack to cool.
Combine the lime juice and ginger in a small bowl and let stand 10 minutes to soften. Whisk in the remaining 1/4 cup palm oil until emulsified. Season.

Toss the collards with 1 tablespoon of the dressing and massage it into the greens for about 5 minutes. Transfer to a platter, top with the sweet potatoes, goat cheese and cashews. Serve the remaining dressing on the side.
chefTips: Printed cues: potatoes ‘golden brown’; lime and ginger stand ‘to soften’; dressing ‘until emulsified’.
Organic fair-trade red palm oil is sold at West African specialty grocers (the page’s note).
commonMistakes: Crowding the sweet potatoes so they steam.
Skipping the massage; the greens stay tough.
healthBenefits: Greens, sweet potato and cashews add fibre, vitamin A and healthy fats.
culturalNote: A Senegalese-inspired American holiday salad; the page names no region or ethnic group.
sources: Title as printed: ‘Shredded Collard Green Salad With Roasted Sweet Potatoes and Cashews’. NO byline on the recipe page (two-pass); photograph credit ‘Photography by Ryan Liebe’; other bylines on the page belong to unrelated ‘Keep Reading’ items. Parent-article byline and credited author: Pierre Thiam. SAVEUR, 16 November 2015. Serves 6–8 (7 used); total time printed 1 hour. TWO-PASS on every quantity.
Times: about 40 minutes roasting; 10 minutes standing; about 5 minutes massaging (counted inside the prep of 10). ABSENT: salt and pepper amounts.
